notes.title: Our new game 'Goalgetter' is now released!
notes.content:
We believe that fans of Handball Action Total will also find great joy in playing 'Goalgetter'.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676860

'Goalgetter' is a comprehensive football career simulator that allows you to fulfill your dream of becoming a top striker in one of the major European leagues. As a young and talented striker, you can secure your place through intense training or other means, all while managing your personal life decisions, financial investments, and career choices.

notes.title: Handball World Cup discount
notes.content: Just in time for the Handball World Championship in Poland and Sweden, we are offering a great discount for our handball action game for PC.

notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign for our new game Goalgetter
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the Kickstarter campaign for Goalgetter is out today.
Please support our game, you won't regret it!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thomasschreiber/goalgetter-torschutzenkonig]
Visit Kickstarter campaign![/url]

The Kickstarter campaign features - beside the game - exclusive products such as autographs, posters, footballs, jerseys, and trophies all signed by Ailton.
 
The campaign has set modest EUR 20,000 as funding goal and offers very attractive bonuses for reaching stretch goals. From EUR 100,000 all DLC for the game will be free. With higher financing amounts, even games up to a value of EUR 80 could be free.

We hope to motivate football manager fans with our idea of simulating a football player's career, to support our game. If you are quick, you will receive fantastic special offers as an "early bird".

Many thanks for your support!

From the country where the printing press was invented, Karl Marx saw the light of day and probably the best Riesling wine is grown now comes an incomparable indie game bundle: 

The Indie Pearls from RLP. We are local indie studios and have teamed up to bring you a good choice of regional products for the first time as a joint Rhineland-Palatinate bundle. Complete your collection and get these indie gems now for [b]-20% off[/b]!

In this bundle, you'll find great games from developer studios from all over Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. Included are games by the studios 
[b]Grimbart Tales[/b], [b]Binary Impact[/b], [b]Rhine Games[/b], [b]netmin games[/b], [b]Gentlymad[/b], [b]Sleeping Forest Interactive[/b] and [b]Andarion Games GmbH[/b].

notes.title: -50% at Remote Play Together 2022 event
notes.content:
Hello handball friends and sports enthusiasts! ⛹️♀️🚀

To celebrate the [b]Remote Play Together 2022[/b] event, we would like to offer you a high reduction of a whopping [u][b]-50%[/b][/u]! 

The most fun you can have with Handball Action Total is together with friends. All you need is the game and a friend. Thanks to the remote play feature you can easily play together. Your teammate only needs an invitation link.

We at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41585244]netmin games[/url] wish you a lot of fun at this event and especially with Handball Action Total.

notes.title: Handball Action - Remoteplay together
notes.content:
We have tested the [b]remoteplay function[/b] here in the studio and had so [b]much fun[/b] that we also wanted to remind you that you can have this experience with your friends (and those who could still become friends) at any time!

[b][i]What do you need for this?[/i][/b]

One player must own the game on Steam. The owner then invites his teammate and you can start playing. 

It's definitely worth it to dive into the atmosphere again, spend one or two evenings with friends and Handball Action Total.

Feel free to show us your screenshots.

We wish you a lot of fun, a nice advent season with your loved ones and stay healthy.

[b]netmin games[/b]
